notes.title: Purple Lamp‘s faithful remake Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7564110/e8b9a9fc23b5fb3131d0b16ff735b278c88e473b.png[/img]

[h2]Epic Mickey is Back! Unleash the Power of the Brush in Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed — Available NOW[/h2]
 
Vienna, Austria - September 24, 2024: The wait is over! Epic Mickey is back, and this time, the stakes are truly epic! Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed, the highly anticipated remake of the beloved classic, developed by Purple Lamp in collaboration with Disney Games and published by THQ Nordic, is now available on Nintendo® Switch, PS4™, PS5™, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.

Watch the release trailer here: https://youtu.be/uI5t2oXQSAg

Mickey Mouse’s adventure with magic ink has gone awry, and he soon finds himself pulled into the dangerous world of Wasteland, a realm where forgotten Disney characters reside. In Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed, players will step into Mickey’s shoes and take control of his magical brush to restore the world around him or use paint and thinner to reshape the environment and uncover hidden secrets.

Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed brings the classic 2010 game back and for the first time ever, is available to modern consoles with enhanced visuals and graphics. New gameplay features include dash, ground pound and sprint allowing fans of the original and newcomers alike more ways to navigate Wasteland and combat enemies. Along with the magic paint brush, players can explore the unpredictable world of Wasteland, with levels inspired by classic Disney stories, and meet familiar faces along the way.

Get the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522160/Disney_Epic_Mickey_Rebrushed/

Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed is available now for Nintendo® Switch, PS4™, PS5™, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and PC at an SRP of € 59.99 / $ 59.99 / £ 49.99 / AU$ 99.95 / ¥ 6578.

Not sure yet? Enjoy the great Steam demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3043870/Disney_Epic_Mickey_Rebrushed_Demo/

Follow @thqnordic for all Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed news and updates.

Enjoy & stay tuned!

notes.title: THQ Nordic's Digital Showcase Unveils New Games, Gameplay, and Exciting Teasers!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7564110/623a29087cbcf56540983486bb25d9c5737c1f81.jpg[/img]

[b]Shots Fired: THQ Nordic's Digital Showcase Unveils New Games, Gameplay, and Exciting Teasers![/b]
 
Vienna/Austria - August 2nd, 2024: The stage lights have dimmed, and the 2024 THQ Nordic Digital Showcase has officially taken its final bow! We've had a blast unveiling a treasure trove of game updates, reveals, and surprises. Missed the live show? No worries! You can catch all the action on demand across our official channels: 

Re-watch the Showcase:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BWI5exTf9hs

[h2]THQ Nordic Publisher Sale on Steam[/h2]
We're rolling out the red carpet for our biggest sale of the year! To celebrate our latest announcements and all the games you love, we're slashing prices like monsters in Titan Quest II. From August 1st, 19:00 CEST / 10:00 AM PDT to August 15th, 19:00 CEST / 10:00 AM PDT, you can grab dozens of our titles at blockbuster discounts - get Darksiders III for 80% off, the Titan Quest Anniversary Edition for 80% off, or snag South Park: Snow Day at 50% off! It's the perfect way to tide you over while you wait for our upcoming hits. Don't miss out — check out the discounted games, upcoming releases, and playable demos right here:

https://store.steampowered.com/sale/THQNordicPublisherSale2024


And now to the best part - here's everything shown in THQ Nordic's Digital Showcase 2024: 

[h2]The Eternal Life of Goldman [/h2]
You didn't see this one coming, even after we shared a few hints. This brand-new IP is developed by Weappy Studio, the creative masterminds behind This Is the Police 1+2, Rebel Cops, or This Is the President. The Eternal Life of Goldman is a breathtaking platformer adventure where you explore a vast hand-drawn Archipelago, inspired by ancient fables and depicted in classic frame-by-frame animation. Your ultimate goal? Defeat a mysterious Deity! 

Check out the announcement trailer: https://youtu.be/MDMPSmoePe4

Wishlist on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2254950/The_Eternal_Life_of_Goldman/

[h2]Space for Sale[/h2]
Interplanetary adventure Space for Sale just launched into Early Access on Steam! Go solo or share the exciting space realtor journey with a friend and double your chances of success in two-player co-op. Venture out in your trusty ship to discover the wonders of the solar system! Be smart about your approach, learn how the local lifeforms survive, and use your discoveries to enhance the structures and gadgets you create. Research, gather resources, and construct your base - cause yes, you've heard correctly, this space is for sale!

Get Space for Sale right now (and enjoy the 20% launch discount!): https://store.steampowered.com/app/1624060/Space_for_Sale/

Watch the trailer: https://youtu.be/lZ_rXr3bNe4

[h2]Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed[/h2]
Embark on a magical journey in Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed! Shape your adventure with the stroke of a brush and transform Wasteland as Mickey Mouse in this beautifully recreated 3D platformer. 
Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed is available for pre-order and is scheduled for release across PS4™, PS5™, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo® Switch and PC on September 24, 2024.
Watch the latest trailer: https://youtu.be/R_ZFP4sDsYk

Pre-order now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522160/Disney_Epic_Mickey_Rebrushed/

[h2]Wreckfest 2 [/h2]
Ladies and Gentlemen, buckle up and prepare to rev your engines! The ultimate thrill ride is back and more explosive than ever -Wreckfest 2 is set to smash onto PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. This highly anticipated sequel takes the chaos of the racetrack to the next level with a completely overhauled physics engine that delivers unparalleled realism in every bone-crunching collision and metal-twisting crash. Get ready to dominate the track with fully customizable cars, allowing you to create your own unique wrecking machine and share your designs with fellow players around the world. Whether you're tuning your ride for maximum destruction or fine-tuning it for a competitive edge, the possibilities are endless. Don't miss out on the mayhem - wishlist Wreckfest 2 now and be among the first to experience the most destructive racing game ever created. 

Watch the announcement trailer: https://youtu.be/PcFycn0BjzE
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203190/Wreckfest_2/

[h2]Titan Quest II [/h2]
The legendary Action RPG is back with a bang! The gameplay premiere for Titan Quest II has just aired, giving players a tantalizing glimpse of what’s to come. Once again, you'll be plunged into the mythological world of ancient Greece, braving formidable challenges, hunting for exquisite loot, and crafting powerful, unique character builds by blending different masteries. Are you ready to carve out your heroic legend?

Forged in the creative crucible of Grimlore Games in Germany, Titan Quest II is currently under development. This epic odyssey is destined for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series S/X, eagerly anticipated to launch when the time comes.

Check out the gameplay reveal trailer: https://youtu.be/uGQ_9OK8pPI
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1154030/Titan_Quest_II/

[h2]Gothic 1 Remake[/h2]
Welcome back to the new and visually stunning Colony: The Gothic 1 Remake unveils gameplay for the first time, taking players back to familiar places - but now in the astonishing splendor of Unreal Engine 5! Dive deeper into the lore, explore combat and magic, and immerse yourself in a living world where fans might discover some hidden new details. Check out Gothic Remake's first gameplay trailer and enjoy the experience!

Watch the gameplay trailer: https://youtu.be/-pwcnbZtATQ

The Lintukoto Reserve DLC features a diverse array of environments and is home to a rich variety of wildlife, including the elusive Northern Lynx, Mountain Reindeer, Arctic Fox, and the majestic Eurasian Moose. Whether observing from a high vantage point or quietly watching by the river deltas, every moment in Lintukoto Reserve brings a new sight and a deeper connection to nature.

notes.title: Back For Good: THQ Nordic Will Be At gamescom 2024!
notes.content:
Whatever we said, whatever we did - we didn't mean it, we just will be back for good! We are thrilled to announce that after a year of absence, THQ Nordic is making a grand return to Cologne for gamescom 2024.

Get ready to immerse yourself in Germany's most iconic gaming franchise as the Gothic Remake will be playable at our booth. We eagerly await fans' feedback on this highly anticipated release!

[b]But that's not all! Attendees will also have the opportunity to play Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed. This remake of the 2010 beloved classic, originally envisioned by legendary game designer Warren Spector, takes Mickey Mouse on an epic journey through the Wasteland, a realm of forgotten Disney characters.[/b]

The excitement continues with Titan Quest II, an ARPG where you can be among the first in the world to embark on an odyssey for fame, loot, and XP.

We have two more titles playable in Cologne, but we’re keeping those under wraps for now. Stay tuned for their announcement just before gamescom opens on August 21st. Be sure to watch the THQ Nordic Digital Showcase on August 2nd, 2024, for all the details:

Check out the THQ Nordic Digital Showcase 2024 website: https://showcase.thqnordic.com/


[b]THQ Nordic's playable games at gamescom 2024, Hall 7.1, Booth A11/B10
- Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed[/b]
- Gothic Remake
- Titan Quest II
- "unannounced game #1"
- "unannounced game #2"

[b]THQ Nordic's gamescom lineup will be streamed[/b]

Can't make it to Cologne? We've got you covered! THQ Nordic is teaming up with well-known content creators and international press outlets to stream live from our booth directly to your screens. Expect in-depth interviews with our developers and your favorite content creators streaming our games. As gamescom approaches, we’ll share more information about the participating channels and outlets.

Join us at gamescom 2024 for an unforgettable gaming experience!

notes.title: REVISIT A BELOVED CLASSIC WITH DISNEY EPIC MICKEY: REBRUSHED
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7564110/e83b61797d7bb0c9496c9149352b839abe646436.jpg[/img]

[h2]REVISIT A BELOVED CLASSIC WITH DISNEY EPIC MICKEY: REBRUSHED[/h2]

[b]Embark on a magical adventure in Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed – an enhanced remake of the 2010 classic![/b]
 
Vienna, Austria, February 21, 2024: THQ Nordic today announced that Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed, a faithful remake of the beloved classic adventure, is being developed by Purple Lamp in collaboration with Disney Games. The development team was assisted in the remaster by Warren Spector, director of the original Disney Epic Mickey. In this classic action-adventure game, players will send Mickey Mouse, armed with a magical paintbrush, on an epic creative journey to brave the dangerous world of Wasteland. Through exciting levels inspired by classic Disney stories, players will paint their path and face a variety of challenges along the way. Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed is scheduled for release across PS4™, PS5™, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo® Switch and PC in 2024.

A first look at Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed can be found here: https://youtu.be/EF4XVQ0d5kk

“[i]I’ve received more heartfelt fan mail from players of all ages about Disney Epic Mickey than any other project I’ve worked on – a true indicator of the timelessness of this game,[/i]” said Warren Spector, director of the original Disney Epic Mickey. “[i]That my team and I contributed to that legacy is truly an honor and I’m delighted that old fans and new will get to enjoy the adventures of Mickey and Oswald in Wasteland once again.[/i]”

“[i]Having been part of this from the earliest beginnings of the creative idea, all those years ago, I can’t wait to see new players discover this enduring classic on modern consoles,[/i]” said Luigi Priore, V.P. of Disney, Pixar and 20th Century Games. “[i]We are excited that fans of the original will also get to relive their own experiences wielding the paintbrush and thinner once again.[/i]”

Make sure to wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522160/Disney_Epic_Mickey_Rebrushed/

Follow @thqnordic for all Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed news and updates.

Enjoy & stay tuned!
